# Harvard Graduate School of Education

> Harvard GSE is a leading graduate institution offering master's and doctoral programs in education, research initiatives, and comprehensive student support services.

The Harvard Graduate School of Education (HGSE) provides advanced degree programs, career development, and research opportunities for education professionals. The school maintains extensive resources including the Monroe C. Gutman Library, career services, student affairs support, and a robust alumni network.

## Key Topics

- Master's programs
- Doctoral programs
- Educational research
- Career services
- Student support
- Alumni community
- Professional development
- Admissions
- Academic resources
- Usable Knowledge
- Strategic Data Project
- Student wellness
- Employer relations
- Library resources
- Academic calendar

## Degree Programs

- [Degrees and Programs](https://www.gse.harvard.edu/degrees): Master's and doctoral degree programs at Harvard GSE including online options

## Student Services & Support

- [Office of Student Affairs](https://osa.gse.harvard.edu): Student Affairs office offering academic support, wellness, and accessibility services
- [Career Services Office](https://cso.gse.harvard.edu): Career Services Office overview with staff directory and student support resources
- [Office of the Registrar](https://registrar.gse.harvard.edu): Registrar office providing enrollment, transcripts, and academic calendar information

## Academic Resources

- [Gutman Library](https://www.gse.harvard.edu/community/library): Monroe C. Gutman Library serving Harvard and education community with research resources

## Community & Alumni

- [Alumni Community](https://www.gse.harvard.edu/community/alumni): HGSE alumni community hub with networking, events, and lifelong learning resources

## About Harvard GSE

- [Homepage](https://www.gse.harvard.edu): Harvard GSE homepage presenting mission, degree programs, and research initiatives
